players.name: Mouhamed Gueye
players.detail: Foot — Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

players.name: Keshon Gilbert
players.detail: Hip — Gilbert (hip) won't play in Saturday's Las Vegas Summer League game against the Wizards, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

players.name: RayJ Dennis
players.detail: Achilles — Dennis (Achilles) has been ruled out for Saturday's Summer League game against the Wizards, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

players.name: Jayson Tatum
players.detail: Knee — Tatum (knee) should once again serve as the unquestioned centerpiece of Boston's offense after the Celtics traded Jaylen Brown for Paul George, John Schuhmann of NBA.com reports.

players.name: Nolan Traore
players.detail: Knee — Brooklyn general manager Sean Marks announced Monday that Traore underwent right knee surgery and won't play in Summer League, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.

players.name: Brandon Miller
players.detail: Shoulder — Miller (shoulder) provided an update on his rehab after surgery in comments to Roderick Boone of The Charlotte Observer on Tuesday.

players.name: PJ Hall
players.detail: Ankle — The Hornets announced Thursday that Hall underwent a procedure to address a fractured right ankle and will miss the remainder of the 2025-26 campaign.

players.name: Dailyn Swain
players.detail: Wrist — Swain is out for Friday's Summer League game against the Cavaliers due to right wrist soreness, per K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network.

players.name: Zach Collins
players.detail: Toe — Collins (toe) agreed to a two-year, $17 million extension with Chicago on Tuesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Josh Giddey
players.detail: Ankle — Giddey (ankle) could benefit from the selections of Caleb Wilson and Dailyn Swain as well as Chicago's acquisition of Nic Claxton (finger) in 2026-27.

players.name: Rob Dillingham
players.detail: Wrist — Dillingham recently underwent successful minor surgery to have a ganglion cyst removed from his right wrist, the Bulls announced Wednesday.

players.name: Kyrie Irving
players.detail: Knee — Irving (knee) has been playing in pickup games this offseason in an effort to ramp up toward his return to the court in 2026-27, Tim MacMahon of ESPN reports.

players.name: Santi Aldama
players.detail: Knee — Aldama (knee) is expected to be ready in time for training camp, according to NBA reporter Marc Stein.

players.name: Dereck Lively II
players.detail: Foot — Lively (foot) still hasn't progressed to running yet, per Christian Clark of The Athletic.

players.name: Trevon Brazile
players.detail: Undisclosed — Brazile is out for Sunday's Summer League finale for undisclosed reasons, Ryan Blackburn of MileHighSports.com reports.

players.name: Jimmy Butler III
players.detail: Knee — Butler (knee) is still in the relatively early stages of his recovery and has only recently begun getting back on the court, according to Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com.

players.name: Moses Moody
players.detail: Knee — Moody has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Fred VanVleet
players.detail: Knee — Head coach Ime Udoka said Friday that VanVleet (knee) is ramping up his rehab work, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

players.name: Kevin Durant
players.detail: Ankle — Durant (ankle) averaged 26.0 points per game during his first season with Houston and continued to cement his place among the NBA's all-time great scorers, moving into the top five on the league's career 30-point games list.

players.name: Steven Adams
players.detail: Ankle — The Rockets announced Wednesday that Adams has undergone season-ending left ankle surgery, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: Tyrese Haliburton
players.detail: Achilles — The Pacers may opt to slowly bring Haliburton back up to speed as he aims to return from a torn Achilles suffered in Game 7 of the 2025 NBA Finals, Jamal Collier of ESPN reports.

players.name: Johnny Furphy
players.detail: Knee — Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

players.name: Brandon Ingram
players.detail: Heel — The Clippers and Raptors both agreed Monday to finalize the trade sending Leonard to Toronto for Brandon Ingram (heel), Gradey Dick, two unprotected first-round picks, one first-round pick swap and two second-rounders, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jordan Miller
players.detail: Shoulder — Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

players.name: Bradley Beal
players.detail: Hip — Beal (hip) agreed to a two-year, $13.2 million contract with Los Angeles on Thursday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
players.detail: Foot — Niederhauser has been diagnosed with a Lisfranc injury in his right foot and will require surgery. He's been ruled out for the remainder of the 2025-26 season, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.

players.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
players.detail: Toe — Pippen (toe) has a chance to begin the new year as Memphis' starting point guard after Portland acquired Ja Morant in a trade with the Grizzlies earlier this offseason.

players.name: Walter Clayton Jr.
players.detail: Knee — Clayton (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League title game against the Warriors, Drew Hill of The Daily Memphian reports.

players.name: Karim Lopez
players.detail: Undisclosed — Lopez (undisclosed) is out for Sunday's Summer League championship game against the Warriors, Drew Hill of The Daily Memphian reports.

players.name: Richie Saunders
players.detail: Knee — Saunders was selected by the Grizzlies with the No. 32 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft.

players.name: Jaylen Wells
players.detail: Toe — Wells (toe) should continue competing for rotation minutes on the wing despite Memphis adding Cameron Boozer with the No. 3 overall pick.

players.name: Zach Edey
players.detail: Ankle — Edey's (ankle, elbow) role becomes more intriguing following Memphis' addition of Cameron Boozer.

players.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
players.detail: Knee — Antetokounmpo (knee) did not participate in Greece's latest FIBA World Cup qualifying window as he focused on preparing for the 2026-27 NBA season.

players.name: Bam Adebayo
players.detail: Back — Adebayo's (back) fantasy outlook should remain strong after Miami acquired Giannis Antetokounmpo, though his offensive role could shift alongside another high-usage frontcourt star, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sentinel opines.

players.name: Trevor Keels
players.detail: Knee — Keels (knee) didn't play in Friday's 101-87 Summer League win over the Pistons.

players.name: Ryan Conwell
players.detail: Hip — Conwell (hip) won't play again during the Las Vegas Summer League, per Tim Reynolds of Associated Press.

players.name: Myron Gardner
players.detail: Ankle — Gardner (ankle) won't participate in the Las Vegas Summer League, per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.

players.name: Kevin Porter Jr.
players.detail: Knee — Porter exercised his $5.39 million player option for the 2026-27 campaign Thursday, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

players.name: Donte DiVincenzo
players.detail: Achilles — DiVincenzo will undergo surgery Sunday to repair a ruptured right Achilles tendon that he suffered during the Timberwolves Game 4 win over the Nuggets on Saturday.

players.name: Bryce McGowens
players.detail: Toe — McGowens (toe) is out for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves.

players.name: Mohamed Diawara
players.detail: Finger — Diawara (finger) didn't play in Friday's 110-88 Summer League loss to the Mavericks.

players.name: Jalen Brunson
players.detail: Wrist — Brunson is set to undergo surgery on his right wrist/forearm area Tuesday and is expected to require at least two months of rehab, Ian Begley of SportsNet New York reports.

players.name: Isaiah Hartenstein
players.detail: Ankle — Hartenstein (ankle) participated in an offseason workout with the Thunder on Monday, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

players.name: Ajay Mitchell
players.detail: Calf — According to Bryan Toporek of Forbes, Oklahoma City's offseason roster shakeup opened additional opportunities in the backcourt after the departures of Isaiah Joe, Aaron Wiggins and Luguentz Dort.

players.name: Otega Oweh
players.detail: Lower Leg — Oweh (lower leg) didn't play in Sunday's 108-90 Summer League loss to the Nets.

players.name: Thomas Sorber
players.detail: Knee — Sorber underwent a successful minor arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Wednesday and will return to full basketball activities in approximately four weeks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

players.name: Jalen Williams
players.detail: Hamstring — Williams (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's Game 7 of the Western Conference Finals against the Spurs.

players.name: Nikola Topic
players.detail: Back — Topic (back) underwent surgery Saturday and is expected to be ready for the start of training camp, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.

players.name: Franz Wagner
players.detail: Calf — Wagner (calf) did not participate in Germany's latest FIBA World Cup qualifying window as he focuses on preparing for the 2026-27 NBA season.

players.name: Izaiyah Nelson
players.detail: Ankle — The Magic announced Monday that Nelson will undergo surgery to repair a fracture in his left ankle, and he's expected to return to basketball activities in 3-4 months.

players.name: Jonathan Isaac
players.detail: Knee — Isaac (knee) will return to the Magic on a one-year deal, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

players.name: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
players.detail: Finger — Caldwell-Pope (finger) agreed to a buyout with the Grizzlies on Saturday and plans to sign a one-year, $3.9 million contract with the 76ers, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Mark Williams
players.detail: Shoulder — Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: CJ Huntley
players.detail: Hamstring — Huntley (hamstring) is out for Saturday's Las Vegas Summer League finale versus the Spurs, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

players.name: Ja Morant
players.detail: Elbow — Morant is set to share the playmaking duties with Damian Lillard in Portland's starting backcourt after being traded from Memphis.

players.name: Shaedon Sharpe
players.detail: Knee — Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: Damian Lillard
players.detail: Achilles — Lillard (Achilles) defeated Devin Booker and Kon Knueppel in the final round of Saturday's 2026 State Farm 3-Point Contest, taking home his third title.

players.name: Domantas Sabonis
players.detail: Knee — Sabonis (knee) did not participate in Lithuania's latest FIBA World Cup qualifying window as he turned his attention toward preparing for the 2026-27 NBA season.

players.name: Keegan Murray
players.detail: Ankle — Murray (ankle) is projected to start at power forward for the Kings in 2026-27, according to Kings beat writer Chris Watkins.

players.name: Zach LaVine
players.detail: Hand — LaVine (hand) exercised his $49 million player option for 2026-27 on Monday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: De'Andre Hunter
players.detail: Eye — Hunter (eye) has a major competitor for usage after the Kings took Darius Acuff in the 2026 WNBA Draft.

players.name: David Jones Garcia
players.detail: Ankle — Jones Garcia (ankle) agreed to a two-way contract with the Spurs on Wednesday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.

players.name: Jayden Quaintance
players.detail: Knee — Quaintance underwent right knee surgery Wednesday and has no timetable for a return, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Nate Bittle
players.detail: Lower Leg — Bittle (lower leg) was spotted in a walking boot Wednesday, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Alijah Martin
players.detail: Knee — Martin (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Nuggets, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet reports.

players.name: Chucky Hepburn
players.detail: Knee — Hepburn (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Nuggets, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet reports.

players.name: Collin Murray-Boyles
players.detail: Finger — Murray-Boyles (finger) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Nuggets, Zulfi Sheikh of sportsnet reports.

players.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
players.detail: Knee — With Walker Kessler now in Los Angeles, Jackson (knee) figures to be an even more essential piece for the Jazz in 2026-27, per ESPN's Tim MacMahon.

players.name: Trey Alexander
players.detail: Ribs — Alexander (rib) is out for Friday's Summer League game against Portland, per Ben Anderson of KSL News Salt Lake City.

players.name: Jamir Watkins
players.detail: Knee — The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

players.name: Alex Sarr
players.detail: Foot — Washington's selection of AJ Dybantsa likely won't significantly alter Sarr's role heading into his third NBA season

players.name: Anthony Davis
players.detail: Finger — The Wizards selected AJ Dybantsa with the No. 1 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, adding another high-usage scorer to the roster.

players.name: Trae Young
players.detail: Quadriceps — Young (quadriceps) plans to sign a four-year, $212 million deal with the Wizards, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
